method: Independent derivation and numeric verification, separate from rendered appearance
derivation: Arc-length parameterization r′(s)=(cosφ,sinφ) has unit speed and curvature φ′. For φ=ks²/(2L), curvature ramps from zero to k; circular curvature is constant k. At fixed speed v, normal acceleration is v²κ. The end tangent can be continued by a radius-1/k circle.
limitations: Compared transitions have different endpoints and headings.
Continuous acceleration is not zero jerk; banking and full road design are excluded.
